other_conditions: The Self‑Help Group must have at least 10 female artisans.
The applicant must belong to one of the listed sub‑castes among scheduled castes (e.g., Arundathiyar, Chammadiya, Chamar, etc.).
The applicant's annual family income must not exceed ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas.
The applicant or any family member must not have received benefits from other schemes, except training programmes.
Family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,50,000 per SHG (each member receives a ₹15,000 subsidy and a ₹10,000 loan).
